messages:
ara (People Ops): Quick sync 1  Wee28099re sending out the new "Kudos Care" pouches next week to recognize folks who closed cross-team OKRs. Need assembly leads, postage plan, and confirmation on the international customs form for APAC recipients. Can volunteers sign up?
ben (Events): Happy to lead SF build on Wed 6/18 3-5pm. How many total kits and what's inside? :raised_hands:
ara (People Ops): Total 82 kits: SF 30, NY 22, Remote (global) 30. Contents: hard enamel pin, mini snack, 1-line manager card (handwritten), QR link sticker for shoutouts, a tiny thank-you postcard, and a small desk sticker.
chui (Logistics): For internationals we need CN customs info for 6 addrs and EU CN22s for a few. I can prep customs forms if I get weights by EOD tomorrow. Also recommend separating builds by region to avoid mix-ups.
nora (Finance): Budget code: 7-RECOG-2026. If the unit cost runs > $20 flag me. Confirmed vendor invoiced for pins.
mail-bot: Inventory check: pins 100, stickers 150, snacks 90, blank cards 120, bubble mailers 60.
ben (Events): Volunteers: ben, kira, jules for SF. Need two more. NY volunteers?
ara (People Ops): NY lead? Samir can own NY pack on Tue evening. Remote kits will be packed in NY then shipped internationally on Wed morning.
chui (Logistics): I'll own customs paperwork and international labels. Can someone provide per-kit weight after a sample kit is sealed?
ben (Events): I'll assemble a sealed sample today and post weight. Also bringing label printer + pens.
ara (People Ops): Manager note guidance: 1-line prompt: "Thanks for helping XYZ ship faster — your work mattered to [team name]." We'll provide pens and a handwriting station.
nora (Finance): Approving estimated spend now. Please use code 7-RECOG-2026. If any express international shipping required ping me.
ben (Events): Checklist draft:
- Finalize recipient CSV
- Print blank manager cards (do not pre-fill)
- Build kits by office grouping
- Add "do not open until retro" sticker for surprise deliveries
- Photograph 2 kit samples and upload to #culture-photos
- Hand over remotes to courier with tracking

chui (Logistics): Need CSV by 6/16 EOD. I'll run address validation + dedupe and return cleaned file by 6/17 noon.
ara (People Ops): Volunteers needed: two SF spots filled by tanya + leo; NY still needs 3. I'll ping ambassadors.
mail-bot: Reminder set: CSV validation due 2024-06-16T23:00:00Z
ben (Events): Sample sealed weight: 185g. Chui, pls use that for postage estimates.
chui (Logistics): Thanks. Ordering 40 mailers and extra tape. Courier pickup scheduled for NY 6/18 09:30.
ara (People Ops): Great work team. Final timeline: 6/16 CSV -> 6/17 QA -> 6/18 build & ship -> 6/19 delivery during retros. I'll post final packing sheet when CSV is live. :sparkles:
